pack.pack_markdown:
# Pocket Weather Clerk — Interaction Wireframe Pack v0.2
Core: Weather Desk. Portrait mobile, 0–100 coordinates, direct-manipulation first. Six inventory surfaces are represented: Shift Board, Order Brief, Weather Desk, Pause Overlay, Order Result, Shift Complete. Weather Desk exposes target strip, adjustment counter, cloud hit area, town feedback, wind rotary, humidity valve, Observe, Submit and settle progress. Gesture ownership is single-pointer; continuous motion commits once on release. Adjusting → settling → adjusting is the main micro-loop; Submit enters evaluating and then Result. Invalid/locked inputs never mutate game state. Data is five weather orders. Godot ownership: AppRoot for shift progression; WeatherSession for order variables/rules; UI is presentation. Acceptance requires complete five-order replay loop, no stale state, and all three gestures affecting the same state evaluated at result.

global_ui_rules.core_rule: town remains visible while controls are manipulated

do not use physics fluid simulation

First Shift completion unlocks Hard Orders exactly once

content_model.authoring: data-driven combinations; no bespoke code per order

design.player_fantasy: 작은 동네의 날씨를 책임지는 기상 사무원으로서 세 변수의 결합을 읽고 최소 조작으로 원하는 미기후를 만드는 숙련감과 즉각적인 환경 변화의 만족을 느낀다.

design.design_markdown:
# Pocket Weather Clerk — Playable Game Design Spec v0.1

## 1. Product Definition
Portrait mobile tactile puzzle/simulation. 4~6분 세션. 구름·바람·습도를 직접 조작해 국지 날씨 주문을 맞춘다. 목표 감각은 촉각적 조정과 환경 반응 읽기. Non-goals: 도시경영, 경제, 복잡 유체물리.
## 2. Player Fantasy
작은 동네의 기상 사무원. 변수 결합을 이해해 원하는 미기후를 만드는 숙련감을 준다.
## 3. Core Player Verbs
Cloud drag, wind circular drag, humidity vertical drag, Observe, Submit. 각 입력은 즉시 월드 피드백과 상태 변화에 연결된다.
## 4. Core Loop
Brief → 상태 읽기 → 장치 조절 → settle 관찰 → 미세조정 → submit → compare → next.
## 5. Round / Session Structure
의뢰 45~90초, 5개가 한 Shift. Retry/Next로 연속 진행.
## 6. Game Rules
Cloud cover/altitude, 8-way wind/strength, humidity. 결합 규칙으로 clear/fog/rain 등을 파생. tolerance 15, budget 8, 3-star 평가.
## 7. State Model
order_brief, adjusting, settling, evaluating, result, shift_complete. evaluating 입력 잠금.
## 8. Interaction Spec
Cloud silhouette drag, nozzle circular drag, valve vertical drag. snap/cancel/locked/disabled 처리 포함.
## 9. Content Model
Weather Order 데이터 = district layout, targets, initial variables, device limits, forbidden states, budget. MVP 5개.
## 10. Difficulty / Variation
단일 목표 → 상충 다중 구역 → 장치 제한/금지 조건/정착 지연.
## 11. Progression
Shift 완료 시 Hard Orders 2개와 새 레이아웃 unlock.
## 12. Economy
Not required.
## 13. Screen Inventory
Shift Board, Order Brief, Weather Desk, Pause Overlay, Order Result, Shift Complete.
## 14. Screen Flow
Board → Brief → Desk ↔ Settle → Evaluate → Result → Retry/Next → Complete.
## 15. Feedback System
그림자, drift, haze, 강수, detent sound, haptic tick, stamp, district compare.
## 16. Visual Direction Brief
Portrait fixed top-down miniature diorama; town central, hardware edges; small-screen readability first.
## 17. MVP Scope
5 orders, three tactile controls, settle/evaluate/result/full Shift loop. Store/season/procedural/final polish 제외.
## 18. Test Scenarios
무설명 Order1, wind spatial effect, all-three-control order, invalid safety, repeat Shift reset.
## 19. Known Risks
규칙 불투명성, 판독성, drag count, 효과 과밀.
## 20. Wireframe Handoff
모든 화면과 hit area, 3 gestures, adjusting/settling/evaluating/result/locked/disabled states, feedback and transitions를 명시한다.
design.round_structure: 의뢰 1개 45~90초. Brief → Adjusting/Settling 반복 → Submit/Evaluate → Result. 5개 의뢰를 한 Shift(4~6분)로 묶고 Result에서 Retry 또는 Next Order로 즉시 이어진다.

interaction_spec.condition: at least one adjustment and not settling

wireframe_handoff: Weather Desk hit area와 3개 장치/target/count/Observe/Submit 표현
adjusting dragging settling evaluating success failure locked disabled variant 표현
district target/current compare와 retry/next transition 표현
design.primary_interaction: 구름을 끌고 바람 노즐을 돌리고 습도 밸브를 조절해 실제 동네 반응을 맞춘다.
design.difficulty_variation: 초반은 단일 구역·단일 목표로 변수 관계를 익힌다. 중반은 두 구역의 상충 목표로 공간 배치와 바람을 결합한다. 후반은 장치 제한·금지 조건·정착 지연을 추가한다. 속도 상승이 아니라 변수 결합과 공간 제약으로 난도를 올린다.
design.visual_direction_brief: Portrait 고정 약간 탑다운 미니어처 디오라마. 동네가 화면 중심, 제어 장치는 가장자리. 구역·구름·날씨 상태가 작은 화면에서 텍스트 없이 읽혀야 한다. MVP는 greybox이며 월드 피드백이 장식 UI보다 우선한다.

feedback: constraints use icons plus short labels
edge_cases: missing order data blocks Start

screens.name: Weather Desk
screens.purpose: core tactile weather manipulation and evaluation entry
feedback: target satisfied preview glow does not award score
edge_cases: multi-touch ignored after first pointer ownership
budget 8 reached disables further device commits and enables submit
locked device never increments adjustment

interactions.action: move cloud within sky; derive footprint
interactions.state_change: cloud position; on release adjustments+1 then settling
wind; on release adjustments+1 then settling
humidity; on release adjustments+1 then settling

state_variants.name: Cloud Dragging
state_variants.notes: town shadow updates live; adjustment commits on release once

implementation_notes: debounce continuous drag into one commit

screens.name: Pause Overlay
edge_cases: pause unavailable evaluating
implementation_notes: overlay scene; do not duplicate desk

screens.name: Order Result
edge_cases: retry does not double-count resolved order

screens.name: Shift Complete
screens.purpose: summarize five orders and unlock hard orders
edge_cases: unlock persistence idempotent
implementation_notes: persist only unlock/progress, not live weather session

nodes.responsibility: Own screen routing, shared gameplay state, rules, persistence, and integration flow.

REQ-RULE-N_0.value: high humidity + low cloud + low wind = fog

REQ-RULE-N_3.value: cloud footprint affects only overlapping districts

REQ-CONTENT-AUTHORING.value: data-driven combinations; no bespoke code per order

REQ-SCORING_RULE-SCORE.value: success 1 star; <=5 adjustments +1; no forbidden overshoot +1

REQ-SCORING_RULE-FAILURE.value: forbidden condition at submit or adjustment budget exceeded
